# Traceability matrix

**Generated file — do not hand-edit.** Regenerate with `npm run traceability`
(`scripts/generate-traceability.ts`), which scans the codebase for `// [FR#]` / `// [NFR#]`
comment tags and cross-references them with test metadata.

This placeholder exists so the path is real and linked from
[architecture.md](architecture.md) before the generator script is implemented. Once
`scripts/generate-traceability.ts` exists, running it will overwrite this file with, at
minimum: each requirement ID, the file(s) and line(s) tagged with it, and which tests exercise
it.
